report_identity.report_title: Nanjing Sinolife United Company Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The Group manufactures and sells nutritional supplements and packaged health food products mainly in Chinese mainland and New Zealand.

segments.name: Manufacture and sale of nutritional supplements and packaged health food products
segments.business_substance: Single reportable segment; goods revenue recognized on delivery.
segments.source: Annual report 2025 Note 4 and Note 5, PDF pages 258-261

business_overview.revenue_model: Sale of goods, generally advance payment for Chinese mainland customers except limited credit sales, and 30-90 day credit terms for customers outside Chinese mainland.
business_notes: Revenue by major market: Chinese mainland RMB649.298 million, New Zealand RMB105.405 million, Australia RMB1.493 million, Vietnam RMB5.485 million, other countries RMB11.245 million.
No single external customer accounted for 10% or more of revenue.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Fair value loss, non-cash investment property mark.

Buildings, leasehold improvements, plant and machinery, fixtures and vehicles.

Annual report 2025 financial position and Note 15, PDF pages 212 and 278
